summary: handleContext (internal/mcp/tools.go) is the MCP "context" tool's payload, front-loaded domain knowledge agents call first. Its content must describe peloton-pp-mcp accurately, not the generator's generic CRM template default: archetype must not be "crm"; tool_count must reflect the actual registered tool count (verified via server.ListTools() -- 30 as of this fix, not the template's stale 10); the resources list must include "performance" and "workout_details" (both parent-keyed dependents of "workouts" with no bulk endpoint) alongside account/classes/strength/workouts; query_tips/playbook must mention sync, offline, and doctor since those are core to this CLI's actual usage pattern; and no CRM-specific language ("Contact lookup", "deal activity", generic throttling advice) may remain. Any future regen must re-verify tool_count against server.ListTools() rather than hand-copying a number, and must re-check the resources list against knownSyncResourceNames()/expandSyncResourcesWithDependents whenever a new syncable resource is added.
reason: SIGNIFICANT #4 from a live post-fix verification sweep (structured findings report against the user's real account): handleContext was a confirmed untouched leftover from the generator's generic template -- "archetype": "crm", "tool_count": 10 (actual was already higher before this session's fixes and is 30 after them), a resources array missing performance (and, after this session's BLOCKING #2 fix, workout_details) with no mention of sync/offline/doctor, and CRM-specific playbook entries that make no sense for a fitness API ("CRM APIs often throttle activity-log endpoints heavily"). Also fixed in the same pass: the two auth env_vars entries had identical stale placeholder descriptions ("Set during initial auth setup.") and required:false, replaced with the accurate per-variable descriptions and required:true already used by internal/cli/agent_context.go's buildAgentContext (kept in sync so the CLI's own `agent-context` command and the MCP context tool describe auth identically); and the command_mirror_capabilities/playbook entries for login had empty rationale/insight strings, now filled in.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New test TestHandleContextDescribesPelotonNotCRM guards archetype != "crm", tool_count >= 20, resources containing performance/workout_details, absence of CRM-template strings, and presence of sync/offline/doctor mentions. Tool count of 30 verified directly via a throwaway server.ListTools() call against the real RegisterTools() registration (not hand-counted), then discarded before commit. Full handleContext JSON output manually reviewed end-to-end for accuracy.
